title: `-t 0` fails inside mmseqs prefilter
body:
`-t` sets the thread count for nail and for mmseqs, with a default of 8. `-t 0` passes validation and fails later with `mmseqs prefilter failed`. A survey of `dev` on 2026-11-02 ran this against the release binary.

## Proposal

Reject 0 at startup with an error that names `-t`, as `PipelineArgs::validate` does for `-a 0`.
close_reason: -t takes a RangedU64ValueParser from 1 in nail/src/args.rs, so clap refuses 0 at parse time. -a moved to the same parser in the same commit. Committed on dev.
